name: Estelle Ceulemans - Annexe, recommandation 12, point 1 - Am 9
title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on psychosocial risk, stress and mental health at work
part_text: Ea. whereas work-related psychosocial risks intensify the burden on healthcare systems and health public expenditures and has a bearing on the financial viability of organisations in both the public and private sector, whereas investing in prevention, early intervention and accessible counselling services reduces pressure on healthcare and social protection systems and constitutes therefore an essential component of preventive public health policy;
